title: War Special Cards Catalog
description: Canonical catalog of collectible Special Cards. Consumed by the validator (authoritative effect resolution) and baked into a client copy. Card `id`s are the stable keys used in state.specials.{player,cpu} and the play_special{id} action.

version.description: Catalog schema/content version. Bump on any breaking change to card ids or effects.

id.description: Stable identifier (snake_case). Used in state.specials and play_special{id}.

name.description: Display name shown in the UI.

when.description: The flip-moment timing window in which the card may be played and its effect resolves inside the deterministic engine.
